Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR MAIZE GERM OILCAKE AS LIVESTOCK FEED INGREDIENT

( First Revision )

o.

FOR E WO RD

0.1 This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted ~)' the Indian Standards Institutions on 31 December 1985, after the draft finalized by the Animal Feeds Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council. 0.2 Maize germ ( Zemays) oilcake consists of the maize germ from which maize starch most of the oil has been expressed during the manufacture and other maize-products. It is used as a livestock feed ingredients. It is also exported.

or

0.3 This standard was first published in 1962. Subsequently one amendment was issued. In this revision requirement for moisture has been modified. For the sake of uniformity in testing, references have been given to IS: 7874 (Part 1 )-1975�. 0.4 Inclusion of the aflatoxin limit in the standard was not found feasible at this stage because of the non-availability of a reliable and quick method for its determination and further, data for fixing a safe limit in the product meant for livestock feed was also not available. However t it was a considered view of the committee for fixing this limit as early as possible.

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded oft' in accordance with IS: 2-1960t. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

IS : 2151 � 1985

1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for maize germ oilcake obtained by the expeller or hydraulic process for use as livestock feed ingredient. 1.1.1 This standard does not cover the solvent-extracted maize germ oilcake. 2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Description - The material shall consist of the maize germ from which most of the oil has been expressed by the hydraulic or expeller process. It shall be free from harmful constituents. It shall be free from rancidity, adulterants, insect or visible fungus infestation. fermented, musty or other objectionable odour. It shall be free from dirt and extraneous matter including metallic pieces. 2.2 The material shall also conform to the requirements prescribed in Table 1.

IS : 2151 � 1985 3. PACKING AND MARKING

3.1 Packing - Unless agreed otherwise between the purchaser and the vendor, the material shall be packed in dry sound jute bags or HOPE bags. The mouth of each bag shall be either machine-stitched or rolled over and hand stitched with strong twine.

3.1 Marldng - Each bag shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the following information:
a) Name of the material;
b) Name of the manufacturer;

c) Net mass in kg, when packed;
d) Batch or code No.: and e) Date of packing. 4. SAMPLING 4.1 Representative samples of the material shall be drawn and conformity of the material in the lot to the requirements of this specification shall be

determined according to the method prescribed in Appendix C of IS: 20521979-. 5. TESTS
5.1 Tests shall be carried out as prescribed in col 4 of Table 1. S.2 Quality of Reagents - Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and distilled water ( see IS: 1070-1977t> shall be employed in tests.
NOTE - � Pure chemicals' shall mean chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the results of analysis.
